svg.desc: B16, ISS BIOGUARD — Retrospective Microgravity Health Evidence. Original project: Multi-drug Resistance of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Under Microgravity Growth Conditions. Session B: Earth & Environmental Engineering. Scientific question: Do archived studies support a reproducible microgravity-associated resistance phenotype, or only context-dependent expression changes? Testable hypothesis: Platform and oxygen-transfer differences may explain a substantial part of observed expression variation; phenotype-linked associations may not generalize from low-shear analogues to spaceflight.. svg.text: Multi-drug Resistance of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Under Microgravity Growth Conditions
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Preserve this project through a non-operational retrospective analysis of
archived omics and documented antimicrobial phenotypes. Assess whether
reported microgravity associations persist after accounting for platform,
strain, oxygen and batch differences. The work does not culture, select,
engineer or experimentally adapt the organism, and does not treat
transcriptional signatures as demonstrated clinical resistance.
Do archived studies support a reproducible microgravity-associated
resistance phenotype, or only context-dependent expression changes?
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Platform and oxygen-transfer differences may explain a substantial part of
observed expression variation; phenotype-linked associations may not
generalize from low-shear analogues to spaceflight.
A transcript difference alone does not establish antimicrobial resistance.
Analogue/spaceflight datasets may differ in strain, sampling and oxygen
Only existing approved records are analyzed; no operational biological
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
Small experiments and incomplete metadata limit confounder adjustment.
Published susceptibility assays may be incomparable, while gene expression
is not a clinical outcome or proof of multidrug resistance.
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.
References are pointers; archive acquisition is separate.
A question becomes a model. A model earns evidence.
NASA-inspired mission names are creative identifiers. This profile describes research design; it claims no NASA approval or flight qualification.
Original titles are preserved. Data pointers and citations do not establish that the original teams’ observations have been acquired.
